patch_description: Add a dedicated fixed-radius center-relaxation phase between LP certification and the final joint nonlinear solve. A nearly jammed joint solve often cannot change its contact graph because every center displacement immediately violates a contact. Deflating the LP radii slightly creates geometric room; maximizing a common clearance variable then moves centers away from walls and active pair contacts in a coordinated way. Restarting the existing joint center/radius optimizer from this repositioned configuration can recover the radii while reaching a different, potentially better boundary-adapted contact graph. This is especially useful for 26 disks, where the best configurations are slightly asymmetric and can be inaccessible from a locked layered local optimum.
